description: Sigma Document Registry — permanent governance documents with authority tiers, owners, lifecycles, and mandatory-when triggers. Project-specific artifacts (DIR-INTENT, FMN-PLAN, DEV-EXEC, DIR-CLOSE) are tracked in progress.json, not here.

semantic_authority.description: Governs interpretation, behavior, and governance decisions.
semantic_authority.note: In any conflict between semantic claims in governance documents, the tier order above resolves: constitutional > operational_governance > agent_rule > agent_config.

runtime_authority.description: Governs current lifecycle state and CLI operation gating.
runtime_authority.note: progress.json does not override constitutional doctrine. It governs operational state: which artifacts exist, what their lifecycle states are, and which CLI operations are permitted right now. In any conflict between a semantic claim in a markdown document and the runtime state in progress.json, the CLI uses progress.json for gate decisions.

documents.lifecycle: living — amended only when Delta Constitution is amended
documents.description: Delta Constitution copy, adapted with Sigma-specific terminology. Governs constitutional principles: Director authority, agent sovereignty, hierarchy of authority, lifecycle governance. If Delta Constitution is amended, this document MUST be updated.

documents.lifecycle: living — extended per phase; never replaced wholesale
documents.description: Sigma operational doctrine. Defines lifecycle, roles, artifacts, state machines, gate rules, naming conventions, folder structure, audit doctrine. Written incrementally per phase; Phase 0A establishes foundational sections.

documents.lifecycle: stable — updated when ARC role definition changes
documents.description: ARC role rule file. Defines ARC responsibilities, permissions, boundaries, and activation protocol. ARC role: interview Director, draft DIR-INTENT. Created in Phase 2.
documents.missing_behavior: Warn on session_bootstrap when ARC role active; do not error on read-only operations.

documents.lifecycle: stable — updated when AUD role definition changes
documents.description: AUD role rule file. Defines AUD responsibilities, permissions, audit scope, and advisory-only constraint. AUD role: brutal auditor, advisory only — not an approval gate. Created in Phase 2.
documents.missing_behavior: Warn on session_bootstrap when AUD role active; do not error on read-only operations.

documents.lifecycle: stable — updated when FMN role definition changes
documents.description: FMN role rule file. Defines FMN responsibilities, permissions, and activation protocol. FMN role: work order + test contract (FMN-PLAN), evaluation of DEV results. Created in Phase 2.
documents.missing_behavior: Warn on session_bootstrap when FMN role active; do not error on read-only operations.

documents.lifecycle: stable — updated when DEV role definition changes
documents.description: DEV role rule file. Defines DEV responsibilities, permissions, and activation protocol. DEV role: implementation plan + report (DEV-EXEC), code execution. Created in Phase 2.
documents.missing_behavior: Warn on session_bootstrap when DEV role active; do not error on read-only operations.

documents.lifecycle: stable — updated when Claude-specific configuration changes
documents.description: Claude-specific bridge file at project root. Configures how Claude reads and operates within this Sigma project. Points to active role rule file and Sigma governance documents. Generated by sigma project start from ~/.sigma/templates/.
documents.missing_behavior: Warn on session_bootstrap; Claude may still operate without it but with reduced governance enforcement.

documents.missing_behavior: Warn on session_bootstrap; Gemini may still operate without it.

documents.lifecycle: stable — updated when general agent configuration changes
documents.description: General agent bridge file at project root. Platform-agnostic configuration for any AI agent operating within this Sigma project. Generated by sigma project start from ~/.sigma/templates/.
documents.missing_behavior: Warn on session_bootstrap; agents may still operate without it.

documents.lifecycle: runtime — read before every CLI operation; written after every state-mutating operation
documents.description: Single source of runtime truth. Tracks lifecycle state, artifact versions and states, gate flags, and STALE_INTENT markers. The CLI reads this before every operation (to check gates) and writes it after every state-mutating operation. Runtime authority: in any conflict between a semantic markdown claim and progress.json, the CLI uses progress.json for gate decisions.
documents.missing_behavior: All CLI operations error with: 'No Sigma project found. Run: sigma project start'

documents.lifecycle: stable — updated when artifact structure changes; templates are embedded by Phase 3 CLI
documents.description: Canonical Markdown templates for all Sigma artifacts, MSG, and the Reference List. Seven files: DIR-INTENT-TEMPLATE.md, FMN-PLAN-TEMPLATE.md, DEV-EXEC-TEMPLATE.md, DIR-CLOSE-TEMPLATE.md, ROADMAP-TEMPLATE.md, MSG-TEMPLATE.md, REFERENCE-LIST-TEMPLATE.md. CLI reads these when generating new artifact documents via sigma intent new, sigma plan new, sigma exec new, sigma close new, sigma roadmap new, sigma send, and the one-time sigma project start / sigma reference update scaffolding of reference-list.md.
documents.missing_behavior: Warn on artifact creation commands; CLI may fall back to inline templates if folder is missing.

documents.lifecycle: runtime — created on first sigma config set; absent = defaults apply
documents.description: Director-scoped project configuration. Stores interaction_language and document_language preferences. Absent until first sigma config set; CLI defaults to English (en/en) when file is missing. Written by: sigma config set. Read by: sigma session bootstrap, sigma config show.
documents.missing_behavior: Default to English for both document and interaction language.

documents.lifecycle: project-wide, cumulative — created once by sigma project start; never versioned per DIR-INTENT
documents.description: Project-wide source index for DIR-INTENT's Comprehensive Research section. Three tables (Local Artifact, Website Link, Online Source Data), each row carrying an ID (LA/WL/OS + sequential number) that DIR-INTENT cites by ID only. Local Artifact rows are synced from Sigma/reference/data/ via sigma reference update, which also auto-assigns the next LA id; Website Link and Online Source Data rows are always manual. Not tracked in progress.json — no lifecycle state, no lock, no gate.
documents.missing_behavior: sigma reference update self-heals a missing file by scaffolding it from REFERENCE-LIST-TEMPLATE.md before syncing.
